content:
julia: Heads up — compliance just asked for a repeatable process to retain customer-specific SIEM archives longer than our default 3y for a small set of enterprise contracts. Need a proposed 'archive consent' workflow so analysts can request/provision access without breaking audit controls.

samir: Which contracts are we talking about? do we have legal sign-off already or is this a new clause?

product-privacy: Only when the customer has an explicit retention addendum. Legal is OK with extension but requires an immutable consent record and proof of customer intent. They want the consent artifact tied to every access grant.

ops-oncall: Infra impact: longer retention -> cold-tiering + lifecycle rules. Also need to limit SIEM export material in hot queries. Suggest compressed parquet + access window to reduce egress risk.

security-bot: automated note: tagging thread for rbac-review. Suggested pattern: create a scoped role (eg. `archived_logs_reader:{project_tag}`) + time-limited credentials and per-request consent checksum. :lock:

elaine: Proposed flow: 1) Customer uploads signed consent PDF to contract portal -> 2) system generates consent_checksum (sha256) and stores metadata encrypted -> 3) analyst files an access request referencing checksum and contract id -> 4) automated approver checks contract validity -> 5) short-lived grant issued (24-168h) with audit entry.

miguel: For SIEM export storage, do we envelope-encrypt the exported blobs with our platform KMS or require customer-managed KMS keys? Mixing approaches will complicate ops.

julia: For Hosted customers we prefer envelope with customer consent recorded; for Private/VPC customers we require customer KMS. Legal wants this spelled out for SOC2 scope. Also need retention label in the blob metadata: `retention_policy=enterprise_ext` and `consent_checksum=<sha256>`.

samir: Can we show an example API call for analysts to request access so product can wire a button in the console? Something simple we can prototype.

elaine: Example request body (internal API):
```
POST /internal/v1/archived-access-requests
{
  "requester":"elaine",
  "project_tag":"acme-payments",
  "contract_id":"ACME-2024-RetentionA",
  "consent_checksum":"e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...",
  "reason":"forensics - transaction dispute",
  "grant_ttl_hours":48
}
```

security-bot: Reminder: every grant must create a single audit row containing: requester, approver, reason, contract_id, consent_checksum, kms_key_id (if used), start_ts, expiry_ts. This row must be exported nightly to the audit sink.

julia: I'll draft an RBAC PR that adds `archived_logs_reader` (scoped by tag) and a small SRE runbook for provisioning + revocation. Who can pick up the KMS envelope integration task?

elaine: I can take KMS integration and the metadata audit export. Will sync with @miguel tomorrow to decide platform-key vs customer-key flows. :thumbsup:

miguel: Sounds good. I'll prep the export storage lifecycle options and cost estimates.

product-privacy: I'll update the compliance checklist and add sample language for customer contracts.

julia: thanks all — please add any blockers here. We'll aim to have a draft PR and runbook by EOW.
